# AWS Secrets Manager

This repository builds a CCF RunnerV2 plugin for AWS Secrets Manager. It collects read-only Secrets Manager metadata, resource policies, version stages, tags, and CloudTrail event history, then evaluates configured Rego policy bundles against one normalized record per secret ARN.

The plugin never calls `GetSecretValue`.

This page is for **operators** who run the `plugin-aws-secretsmanager` plugin with the CCF Agent, and for **developers** who write policies for it. It documents [v0.1.4](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-secretsmanager/releases/tag/v0.1.4) and is generated from the plugin's [README at v0.1.4](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-secretsmanager/blob/v0.1.4/README.md).

## How it works

### CloudTrail Attribution

Secrets Manager events are matched to a secret by ARN, friendly name with suffix, or friendly name without suffix using substring checks against the raw CloudTrail event during collection. This is intentional because many Secrets Manager event types put the identifier in `requestParameters` rather than the structured `Resources` list.

IAM credential-removal events are account-wide. The plugin parses affected `userName`, `roleName`, `userArn`, and `roleArn` from `requestParameters` and attaches the event only to secrets whose resource-policy principal strings substring-match those identifiers. Unmatched IAM events are dropped.

Only normalized event fields are emitted; raw CloudTrail payloads are not included in Rego input.

### Error Scoping

Target-level failures, such as `ListSecrets` or CloudTrail lookup failure for an account/region, are stored once under target scope. They are not copied onto every secret.

Per-secret failures, such as a `GetResourcePolicy` error for one ARN, are attached only to that secret's `collection.errors`. `ResourceNotFoundException` and empty resource policies are valid no-policy states, not errors.

### Out of Scope

KMS key policy, key rotation, and grants are collected by `plugin-aws-kms`; this plugin records only the `kms_key_id` string from Secrets Manager. IAM principal resolution belongs to `plugin-aws-iam`; this plugin records policy principal strings and CloudTrail IAM-event ARNs only. Decrypted secret material is never read.

## Configuration

The CCF agent passes flat string config. Structured values are JSON strings.

| Key | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accounts` | `[]` | JSON array of `{account_id, regions[], role_arn, external_id, session_name, tags{}}`. Empty uses the ambient AWS credential chain. |
| `default_regions` | `[]` | JSON array used when an account omits `regions`; then falls back to the SDK default region. |
| `lookback_days` | `90` | Positive integer up to `90`, used for CloudTrail event history. |
| `policy_inputs` | `{}` | JSON object exposed to Rego as `input.policy_inputs`. |
| `policy_input` | `{}` | Alias for `policy_inputs`. |
| `policy_labels` | `{}` | JSON string map merged into evidence labels. |
| `max_concurrency` | `4` | Positive worker count for account/region targets; `0` is normalized to `1`. |
| `api_timeout_seconds` | `120` | Positive per-target budget covering all paginated Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, and STS calls for one account/region. |

Runtime logs default to `info`. Set `LOG_LEVEL` to `debug`, `info`, `warn`, or `error` to override the level.

## Evidence collected

### Subject

The plugin registers one subject template:

| Name | Type | Identity labels |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aws-secretsmanager-secret` | component | `account_id`, `region`, `resource_id` |

Every evidence record also includes labels: `provider=aws`, `type=secretsmanager`, `subject=aws-secretsmanager-secret`, `account_id`, `region`, `resource_id`, `resource_arn`, `resource_type=secret`, and `account_tag_<key>` for account config tags. `resource_id` is the ARN segment after the final `:` and keeps the AWS 6-character suffix.

### Coverage

CONFIG evidence supports rotation, vendor credential, confidentiality, and privacy policy bundles through `DescribeSecret`, `GetResourcePolicy`, `ListSecretVersionIds`, and tags from `DescribeSecret`. Fields include rotation state, rotation rules, KMS key ID string, owning service, replication status, version stages, resource policy principals, and hashed name/description.

For secrets marked for deletion, the collector records `DescribeSecret` metadata, `deleted_date`, and any matched CloudTrail deletion context, but skips per-secret subresource calls such as `GetResourcePolicy` and `ListSecretVersionIds` because AWS rejects those operations for pending-deletion secrets.

DYNAMIC evidence uses a 90-day default CloudTrail lookback. Secrets Manager events are filtered to `RotateSecret`, `PutSecretValue`, `UpdateSecret`, `UpdateSecretVersionStage`, `DeleteSecret`, `RestoreSecret`, `PutResourcePolicy`, `DeleteResourcePolicy`, `TagResource`, `UntagResource`, `CreateSecret`, and `GetSecretValue`. IAM credential-removal events are filtered to `DeleteUser`, `DeleteAccessKey`, `DetachUserPolicy`, `RemoveUserFromGroup`, `DeleteRole`, `DetachRolePolicy`, and `RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile`.

## Policy input

The plugin evaluates one kind of resource, a Secrets Manager secret, and a policy receives one document per secret as `input`. The document has a `resource.type` of `secret`; the plugin never reads the secret value. Names and descriptions are not sent in clear text: `config.name_hash` and `config.description_hash` carry SHA-256 hashes written as `sha256:` followed by the hex digest. Dates are RFC 3339 strings in UTC, and are an empty string when AWS reports none. The table lists every field with its full path.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | string | Version of this document layout. Always `v1`. |
| `source` | string | Always `aws-secretsmanager`. |
| `account.account_id` | string | AWS account ID the secret belongs to. |
| `account.role_arn` | string | ARN of the role the plugin assumed for the account. Empty when it used its own credentials. |
| `account.tags` | object (string to string) | Tags set on the account in the plugin configuration. Not the secret's tags. |
| `region.name` | string | AWS region the secret lives in. |
| `resource.id` | string | The secret's friendly name followed by the six-character suffix AWS adds, the last part of the ARN. |
| `resource.arn` | string | ARN of the secret. |
| `resource.type` | string | Always `secret`. |
| `config.secret_arn` | string | ARN of the secret, as in `resource.arn`. |
| `config.name_hash` | string | Hash of the secret name. |
| `config.description_hash` | string | Hash of the secret description. The hash of an empty string when there is no description. |
| `config.kms_key_id` | string | KMS key that encrypts the secret. `aws/secretsmanager` when AWS reports none, which means the AWS-managed default key. |
| `config.rotation_enabled` | boolean | Whether automatic rotation is turned on. |
| `config.rotation_lambda_arn` | string | ARN of the Lambda function that rotates the secret. Empty when none. |
| `config.rotation_rules.automatically_after_days` | integer | Days between automatic rotations. 0 when no interval is set. |
| `config.rotation_rules.schedule_expression` | string | Rotation schedule as a cron or rate expression. Empty when none. |
| `config.rotation_rules.duration` | string | Length of the rotation window. Empty when none. |
| `config.last_rotated_date` | string (RFC 3339 time) | When the secret was last rotated. Empty when never. |
| `config.last_changed_date` | string (RFC 3339 time) | When the secret or its metadata last changed. Empty when AWS reports none. |
| `config.last_accessed_date` | string (RFC 3339 time) | The last day the secret value was retrieved. Empty when AWS reports none. |
| `config.deleted_date` | string (RFC 3339 time) | When the secret is scheduled for deletion. Empty when it is not. A secret with a date here has no resource policy or versions in the document, because the plugin skips those calls. |
| `config.recovery_window_days` | integer | Recovery window the secret was deleted with, taken from a matching CloudTrail `DeleteSecret` event. 0 when no such event was found. |
| `config.owning_service` | string | AWS service that manages the secret. Empty for a secret you manage yourself. |
| `config.replication_status` | array of objects | One entry per replica region: `region`, `status`, `last_accessed_date` and `status_message`, all strings. An empty array when the secret is not replicated. |
| `config.resource_policy_present` | boolean | Whether the secret has a resource policy. |
| `config.resource_policy.hash` | string | Hash of the policy text. Empty when there is no policy. |
| `config.resource_policy.document` | object or null | The resource policy as parsed JSON. `null` when there is no policy. `{"_parse_error": "..."}` when the text is not valid JSON. |
| `config.resource_policy.principals` | array of objects | One entry per principal per statement, with `principal` (string), `action` (array of strings), `condition` (the statement's condition object, or null) and `effect` (`Allow` or `Deny`). Empty when there is no policy. |
| `config.versions` | array of objects | Every version of the secret, deprecated ones included: `version_id` (string), `created_date` (string), `kms_key_ids` (array of strings) and `stages` (array of strings, such as `AWSCURRENT`). Empty for a secret scheduled for deletion. |
| `config.deprecated_version_count` | integer | Number of versions that have no stage label. |
| `dynamic.cloudtrail_events` | array of objects | Secrets Manager CloudTrail events in the lookback window that name this secret. Each has `event_name`, `event_time`, `user_identity_arn`, `aws_region`, `event_id` (strings) and `resources` (array of strings). Raw event payloads are not included. Empty when CloudTrail returned nothing. |
| `dynamic.iam_credential_removal_events` | array of objects | IAM credential-removal events, such as `DeleteAccessKey`, whose user or role appears in one of the secret's resource-policy principals. Same fields as `dynamic.cloudtrail_events`. |
| `tags` | object (string to string) | The secret's own tags. |
| `collection.collected_at` | string (RFC 3339 time) | When the plugin collected the data. |
| `collection.collector_version` | string | Always `aws-secretsmanager`. |
| `collection.collection_type` | string | `config_dynamic` when CloudTrail data was collected, otherwise `config`. |
| `collection.lookback_window.start` | string (RFC 3339 time) | Start of the CloudTrail window, set by the `lookback_days` setting. |
| `collection.lookback_window.end` | string (RFC 3339 time) | End of the CloudTrail window. |
| `collection.raw_payload_hashes` | object (string to string) | Hashes of the raw AWS responses under `describe`, `policy` and `versions`. |
| `collection.errors` | array of objects | Failures that affected only this secret, each with `scope` (the secret's ARN) and `message`. Empty when everything succeeded. |
| `policy_inputs` | object | The `policy_inputs` (or `policy_input`) setting from the plugin configuration, passed through unchanged. `{}` when not set. |

## Subject templates

The subject templates this plugin registers. Each example is built from sample data.

### aws-secretsmanager-secret

One Secrets Manager secret, evaluated for compliance posture. Title: `Secrets Manager secret {{ .resource_id }} in {{ .account_id }}/{{ .region }}`. The evidence also carries a `resource_arn` label that is not part of the identity.

| Identity key | Description |
|---|---|
| `account_id` | AWS account ID. |
| `region` | AWS region. |
| `resource_id` | The secret's friendly name followed by its six-character suffix. |

Example:

```json
{
  "name": "aws-secretsmanager-secret",
  "type": "component",
  "title": "Secrets Manager secret payments/db/credentials-AbCdEf in 111122223333/eu-west-1",
  "description": "AWS Secrets Manager secret payments/db/credentials-AbCdEf.",
  "purpose": "Represents a Secrets Manager secret evaluated for compliance posture.",
  "identityLabels": {
    "account_id": "111122223333",
    "region": "eu-west-1",
    "resource_id": "payments/db/credentials-AbCdEf"
  }
}
```
